description: Find 8-K filings that declared a specific SEC Item code. Without cik or ticker it is a market-wide scan over the last N days (max 60), e.g. "every restatement (Item 4.02) this month". With cik or ticker it returns ONLY that company's 8-Ks carrying the item, over a longer look-back (default 90, max 365 days), and also reads the company's own SEC filing index so a filing the store missed is still found; a company with no such filing returns count 0 with a no_match note. Unknown arguments are refused. Common items: 1.01 (material agreement), 1.05 (cyber incident), 2.01 (M&A close), 2.02 (earnings), 4.02 (restatement), 5.01 (change of control), 5.02 (officer departure), 7.01 (Reg FD).

cik.description: Optional. Restrict to one company by SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" for Apple). Leading zeros allowed.

days.description: Look-back window in days. Market-wide: default 7, max 60. With cik or ticker: default 90, max 365.

item.description: SEC Item code like "4.02" or "5.02". Exact match.

ticker.description: Optional. Restrict to one company by US ticker (e.g. "AAPL"). Resolved to its CIK; if cik is also given they must agree.

name: sec_8k_by_item
title: Sec 8k By Item
